title: Practice 1: про-: through, past, and a distance covered

blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.why: **пройти́** — **проходи́ть** — to pass, to go, to walk; to pass by. **прое́хать** — **проезжа́ть** — to go through/by (by horse or vehicle), to ride through/by, to drive through/by; to drive past/along/across. **пролете́ть** — **пролета́ть** — to fly (by, past, through), to fly (over); to overfly, to overshoot. **пробежа́ть** — **пробега́ть** — to run past, to run through; to run a certain distance or for some time. **проплы́ть** — **проплыва́ть** — to swim by, to float by, to sail by; to swim (a certain distance or time), to sail (a certain distance or time). — DLI, Lesson 62.  ·  Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).
exercises.prompt: How did Tom get past the guards?
exercises.context: пройти́** — **проходи́ть — to pass, to go, to walk; to pass by.

exercises.why: The prefix "про-" implies the following meanings: a) Going through — через + Acc.: Мы проехали через лес. b) Passing by — мимо + Gen.: Мы прошли мимо вашего дома. c) Passing between — между + Instr.: Войска противника прошли между лесом и рекой. d) Covering a distance — verb + Acc.: Они прошли два километра. e) Passing (missing) a place or leaving it behind — verb + Acc.: Мы проехали нашу станцию. (missed it) Мы уже проехали этот город. — DLI, Lesson 62.  ·  Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).
exercises.prompt: How did you get past the perimeter?

Мы провели в Европе два месяца. exercises.why: **про-** (temporal) — Prolonged multidirectional movement, with multidirectional verb of motion — Мы проходили по лесу весь день. — We walked around the woods all day. — without prep + acc.. — DLI, Lesson 62.  ·  Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).
exercises.context: про- (temporal) — Prolonged multidirectional movement, with multidirectional verb of motion — Мы проходили по лесу весь день. — We walked around the woods all day. — without prep + acc..
